title: Moroccan Lamb Mrouzia
description: A rich and nourishing Moroccan dessert made with lamb, almonds, and dried fruits.

ingredients.name: ground lamb
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook the lamb to a safe internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: almonds
ingredients.notes: Sliced or slivered almonds work well in this recipe

ingredients.name: dried dates
ingredients.notes: Pitted dates are best for this recipe

ingredients.name: dried apricots
ingredients.notes: Chopped dried apricots add natural sweetness to the mrouzia

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: Use pure honey for the best flavor

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: Melted butter adds richness to the mrouzia

ingredients.name: ground cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality ground cinnamon for the best flavor

ingredients.name: ground ginger
ingredients.notes: Freshly grated ginger is best, but ground ginger works well too

ingredients.name: rose water
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality rose water for the best flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, almonds, dried dates, dried apricots, honey, unsalted butter, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, and rose water. Mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the mrouzia is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve warm, garnished with additional almonds and dried fruits if desired.
